player_prompt.intro: Udi unaya ne: "PegJump" (Diluka dia ku mutshi) udi utangila dibanda dimue pa mutu pa dikuabu mu tshina tshianana, umusha tshintu tshidibu balengeje. Tshipatshila: kujikija ne anu **tshiondo** tshia kuluisha natshi. Tshikadilu tshia malu a kuenza bu mudi '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Diumvuija dia miaku didi kadiyi dimpe. Utela [i->j].

outcome.win: Ndukosa tshilumbu ne mutshi umue mushale!
